text_1: Finally, there’s Adobe Mix Modeler. Powered by Adobe Sensei, Mix Modeler uses AI and machine learning frameworks that let marketing leaders measure and forecast the effectiveness of their campaigns across multiple channels. To achieve this, Mix Modeler uses a combination of marketing mix modeling and multi-touch attribution. Marketing mix modeling processes summary-level data to provide aggregate insights at the channel or product level, while multi-touch attribution processes event-level data to focus on the incremental impact of each individual touchpoint in the customer journey. Mix Modeler is able to share the outputs between these features, producing consistent insights from marketing leaders to measure campaign performance across all channels, optimize budget allocation for marketing spend, and to forecast revenue when planning for different scenario spend mixes on future campaigns.
